technique_name: Compare and contrast the political systems of the United States and Canada.
description: The United States and Canada have democratic political systems. In the US, the federal government is based on a separation of powers, where three branches—the legislative, executive, and judicial—are overseen by an elected president. Canada is a constitutional monarchy with a prime minister and an elected bicameral legislative branch.
